Roofers local rank tracking in New York

For roofers in New York, after a storm the business goes to whoever ranks where the damage is. Eagle Eye grids the whole metro on Google and Apple Maps and shows exactly where you own the pin — and where a rival takes it.

Start with 10 free scans
Industries

New York is dense and walkable, where your rank can flip two avenues over and the pin radius is tight. A single rank for "roofers near me" hides that completely — you can sit first downtown and be nowhere three neighborhoods out, which is where half the calls come from. Eagle Eye lays a grid across the whole New York market and runs a real search from every point, so you see the map the way your customers actually do.

Every scan rolls New York into three numbers — your Local Share of Voice, average rank and the share of points where you crack the top three — plus a competitor map naming whoever outranks you at each pin. Run your first New York scan free, at any grid size, with no card.

Three numbers, every scan

Three numbers a client remembers and a trend that proves your work paid off. Every scan rolls the whole grid into them — no spreadsheet, no hand-waving.

Local Share of Voice
LSOVLocal Share of Voice

How much of the whole grid finds the business near the top — one number for the entire map.

Average Rank, found
ARPAverage Rank, found

The mean position across only the points that return the business at all.

Average Total Rank
ATRPAverage Total Rank

The same average, counting every point that missed the business entirely — the honest one.
